title: Good Day Philly Co-Host Mocked On Live T.V [Watch]
htmlContent:
Emmy-nominated Alex Holley of Good Day Philly joined the FOX 29 news team in the summer of 2014 as co-host of “Good Day Philadelphia. Recently was mocked on live T.V by co-host Mike Jerrick for a dress she wore, that resembled a sofa pattern.

A dress she had never worn seemed appealing and cozy to the naked eye. However, it oddly looked too similar to a couch set you would see at your great-grandmother’s house.

Mike repeatedly trolled the co-host stating that he thought it was from a furniture collection. He sarcastically spoke saying “Well see Raymour and Flanigan design team put this together, uh it’s really nice”.

He could be seen reaching behind her as if he was digging into a couch seat. Removing a hand full of change as well as candy wrappers. After the commercial break the trolling proceeded.

The show continued with Alex wearing plastic over the multi-colored checker print dress. She said the only thing that wasn’t making her feel horrible about the joke is that “it’s also a Beyoncé song”.
